SUMMARY OF DUTIES: Sales associates are the primary service providers and will assist customers in every aspect of the retail business in a friendly, professional, and proactive manner that supports continued customer loyalty.

Sales associates assist their customers in challenging scenarios by using an I can do that mindset, to make all attempts for a positive customer experience and outcomes, before asking for support from the next level mentor or supervisor.

Sales associates are brand and customer program ambassadors for all Marine Corps and MCX programs, including but not limited to, Military Star, Super Star Student, customer satisfaction surveys and Keep it New.

This position can be scheduled throughout the facility, based on the needs of the business including but not limited to, cashier or self-checkout attendant, customer service, salesfloor / department support, stockroom / backroom, and military clothing.

In addition to working indoors, associates may be required to work outdoors or inside coolers and/or chillers. Limited time durations and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided when working inside coolers and/or chillers.

Sales associates who are regularly scheduled in areas are expected to learn basic product knowledge to support customer satisfaction and service.

Sales associates perform store operations tasks such as but not limited to, customer and register transactions, Planogram revisions and setups, identifying missing products, replenish sales floor and coolers, setting promotional signage, visual merchandising, maintaining backroom standards through the 5S program and other operational tasks.

Light housekeeping tasks such as but not limited to, sweeping, dusting and trash removal may be part of daily assigned duties. Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

Assists in preparing and participates in year-end inventory and preparation. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. May require additional training or certifications as required by the business and/or normal working assignments, including but not limited to, food safety training and fuel.

Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all team members through positive conversations and driving customer satisfaction in a teams win environment. Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned.

This is a mixed position where the associate must be able to lift and carry objects up to 45 lbs. independently and objects over 45 lbs. with assistance.
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: At least 1 year experience working in a customer and sales-focused environment is preferred. Cash handling, basic math and register experience strongly preferred. Ability to read and understand operating standards and procedures for service, service recovery, sales and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly. Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals. Attention to detail is required.

At Sunrun, we're on a mission to change the way the world interacts with energy, and we're building a company and brand that puts power at the center of life. To do it, we're designing a dynamic culture where employee development, well-being, and safety come first. It's why we've become the #1 home solar and battery company in America.

We're unlike any other residential energy company. Our vertically integrated model gives us total control over every part of the energy lifecycle - from sale through installation and beyond - so you can find endless opportunities for growth. Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with.

Who We Are We're on a mission to make energy more reliable and affordable for more people. We provide an opportunity with storage and solar to help people access greater energy independence without the big upfront costs.

Sunrun is the largest dedicated residential solar and storage company in the country and has a mission to bring stably priced resilient power to the masses. Overview The Field Sales Consultant self-generates sales leads and presents in-home presentations on our solar products and services for potential customers.

Their priority is to make a genuine human connection with the potential customers with the intent to qualify and vet solar as a viable energy solution for their home and families. If you enjoy face to face interaction, engaging customers and find the idea of working out in the field exciting, then this is the job for you!

Responsibilities/The Impact Develop effective self-generated sales strategies, leads and appointments with potential customers Provide an industry leading customer sales experience from initial contact through installation and after the customer's system is turned on Conduct in-home sales presentations for potential customers and evaluate customers' knowledge and needs, building productive long lasting relationships Handle the pipeline of activity from prospect to install by following up with all leads and in-home consultations Accurately disposition and report on outcomes via our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tool Meet minimum required sales targets as set by sales leadership Qualifications/How You Will Be Successful Minimum of 1 year of sales and/or lead generation experience, with in-home sales experience preferred Must be 21 years of age, possess a valid driver's license, and maintain a clean driving record with the ability to pass a driving background check Excellent communication and teamwork skills needed to partner cross-functionally when addressing customer needs Willingness to spend time traveling within local market, depending on business needs and sales model Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, to accommodate homeowners' schedules Intermediate comfort level with technology, utilizing an IPAD/computer and multiple software applications.

(experience with a CRM is a plus) How you will be Awarded Full benefits package including health, vision, dental insurance, 401K with company match, Employee Stock Purchase Program, paid training, and much more The opportunity to invest in yourself and your career through PowerU - Sunrun's 100% tuition reimbursement program with over 150 educational opportunities A part of the Freedom Time Off (FTO) Plan - Because of the nature of our business, Sunrun cannot guarantee how much time you will be able to take away from work.

Employees on our Freedom Time Off Plan are not limited to a set number of days that they are entitled to take off from work and instead have the freedom to manage how much time off they need!

Highly competitive sales commissions paid biweekly including eligibility for bonus compensation Competitive salary plus lucrative performance incentives through our Nike/Lululemon sponsored incentive program. You'll have the opportunity to earn Nike/Lululemon swag, prizes and amazing trips. Internal advancement opportunities, as earned.

QuickTeam helps US businesses grow by placing high-quality offshore talent — trained, vetted, and ready to work — at a fraction of the cost of hiring locally. We handle recruiting, onboarding, and client support from end to end. We're growing fast and looking for closers who want to be paid for what they actually produce. How this is different?

Most commission roles pay you once per deal and move on. This one keeps paying. Every month a client's virtual assistant is working, you earn. Close a client once, and that account generates income for as long as the VA stays — and our VAs typically stay for years. You're also not starting from scratch.

We have a dedicated lead specialist who continuously researches, qualifies, and contextualizes leads for you, so you're always working a warm pipeline. Your job is to close, not to build a list. What you get Warm, contextualized leads — a dedicated member of our team constantly builds and prepares your pipeline. You come in warm, not cold.

Recurring income — your commission is tied to hours billed by the VAs you place. Active placements mean monthly income, month after month, with no additional effort on your part. Long-term compounding upside — clients who stay for two or three years keep paying you the whole time. Your book of business grows and compounds.

Uncapped earnings in USD — no territory limits, no income ceiling. Full tools and access — CRM, dialer, email, and everything you need to work deals effectively. Backend handled for you — we manage recruiting, onboarding, and ongoing client delivery so you stay focused on selling.

What earnings look like Because commission is tied to hours worked rather than a flat placement fee, income compounds as your book grows. A modest base of a few active long-term clients generates meaningful recurring monthly income in USD — and that base keeps building as you close more.

The commission structure is competitive and discussed in full during the interview. How it works You apply and we walk you through the model, the leads, and the comp. We get you set up with tools and access. You start working leads and closing deals. You get paid — and keep getting paid every month your clients stay active.

Requirements What we're looking for Proven B2B sales or closing experience — staffing, services, SaaS, or similar preferred Exceptional spoken English is non-negotiable. This role is 100% phone-based selling to US business owners and decision makers.

Your voice, clarity, and confidence on a cold call is your product — if a prospect would hesitate for even a moment based on how you sound, this isn't the right fit. Candidates with a neutral, natural-sounding English accent are strongly preferred.

Comfortable working US EST/PST business hours Comfortable working leads by phone, email, and LinkedIn Self-motivated and disciplined — you don't need a manager over your shoulder Experience selling to or supporting US-based clients is a strong advantage Coachable, organized, and consistent in follow-up Hungry for uncapped, USD-denominated, performance-based income This role is not for Anyone expecting a base salary or guaranteed hourly pay People who need constant supervision or hand-holding Reps looking for a 9-to-5 with a predictable paycheck Originally posted on Himalayas

Bring more to life. Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences,diagnosticsand biotechnology? AtBeckman Coulter Diagnostics, one of Danaher ’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—andwe’reall united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’llthrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher ’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

As a global leader in clinical diagnostics, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics has challengedconventionto elevate the diagnostic laboratory’s role in improving patient health for more than 90 years.

Our diagnostic solutions are used in routine and complex clinical testing, and are used in hospitals, reference and research laboratories, and physician offices around the world.

Every hour around the world, more than one million tests are run on Beckman Coulter Diagnostics systems,impacting1.2 billion patients and more than three million clinicians per year.

From uncovering the next clinical breakthrough, to rapid and reliable sample analysis, to more rigorous decision making—we are enabling clinicians to deliver the best possible care to their patients with improved efficiency, clinical confidence, adaptive collaboration, and accelerated intelligence.

Learn about the Danaher Business Syste m which makes everything possible. The Product Sales Executive (Chem/IA) is responsible fordriving growth, expanding market share, and strengthening Beckman CoulterDiagnostics’position within the clinical chemistry and immunoassay market.

About League
League is one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Canada and the leading healthcare experience platform. Getting healthcare is often the easy part — finishing it is where things fall apart: people book the appointment and skip the follow-up, fill the prescription and stop taking it, get the referral and never make the call.

That gap costs health plans and health systems money, and it costs people their health. League closes that gap — identifying what each person needs to do next, clearing what’s in their way, and getting it done, for the 70 million+ people whose care already runs through our platform. Health plans and health systems trust us to do this at scale.

Organizations like Manulife, SCAN, Geisinger, and Medibank on the payer side, and Baptist and Shoppers Drug Mart on the provider side.

This is a build-your-craft role at the front of League's enterprise motion. You will work alongside two to three Account Directors, prospecting into their assigned book of business as the first point of contact between League and healthcare executives owning digital, member experience, AI initiatives, and innovation across North America.
Your core responsibility is conducting deep account research to map League's value proposition to real organizational challenges, then deploying agentic outreach sequences across email, LinkedIn, and direct calls to create discovery meetings and pipelines.
League is an AI-first company and this role is built that way. You will have the tools to research and sequence at a depth that used to take a team, and the support to keep improving how you use them. Your central mandate is to run League's go-to-market system with rigor, and to make it better from the inside.
What You'll Own
Account research and point of view
Research accounts in your Account Directors' book at the level of their actual business: quality performance, digital and AI roadmaps, recent leadership changes, earnings commentary, public filings and app store reviews.
Map League's value proposition to account-specific challenges to build points of view that drive early engagement.
Bring League executives and subject matter experts into accounts where a peer-level conversation opens a door that a rep cannot.
Outreach and pipeline creation
Build and deploy agentic outreach sequences on League's technology stack, across email, LinkedIn and direct calls.
Generate discovery meetings and pipeline while providing Account Directors with high-context research for first calls.
Support marketing events, campaigns and initiatives where League's prospects are a good fit, and follow up on the interest they generate.
The system itself
Execute the go-to-market system with discipline while refining underlying AI workflows, skills, and agents, and share what works with the rest of the team.
Partner with the Marketing team to analyze and iterate on market messaging.
Keep Salesforce accurate and current, because pipeline decisions above you are made from what you record.
Learn the enterprise sales motion end to end, from first touch through opportunity progression.

Ensure access management is performed in compliance with your role and responsibilities.
Execute League's policies and procedures within your team and engagements.
Notify HR, Legal, Compliance & Security of any incidents, breaches, or policy violations.
Comply with Information Security Policies.

Two+ years of outbound sales experience into large enterprises (ideally healthcare). We are hiring for trajectory, not tenure.
A genuine, organic interest in building a sales development career.
Track record of reaching and engaging executive-level buyers.
Fluency with Claude or other AI-native tools, and evidence you fold them into your day-to-day rather than treating them as an add-on.
Strong written communication.
Real curiosity about healthcare and how it is changing. You do not need to know the US healthcare system on day one; you do need to be the kind of person who goes and learns it.
Experience with long, committee-driven enterprise sales cycles.
Experience working alongside senior sellers on account strategy.
Helpful, not required
Exposure to payers, health systems, benefits administrators or consumer health organizations.
Familiarity with Star Ratings, HEDIS, care gaps, benefits navigation and digital front door.
Experience with Salesforce, sales engagement platforms, Artisan or LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
Experience building your own AI workflows, skills or agents.
How You Work
Beyond the functional bar, this seat calls for a specific way of operating:
You listen as well as you talk. You are comfortable picking up the phone and going outbound, and equally able to sit back, hear what is actually being said, and take it in. Neither mode is a stretch for you.
You keep up. You process new information fast: new market, new structure, new process; and you can hold pace with a team that moves quickly..
You run the play. You buy into the system that has been built for you and execute it with discipline. You surface your ideas rather than quietly launching your own version of the stack.
You grind, then you think. You genuinely enjoy the daily rhythm of the work. Within it, you connect dots and find creative angles that the process alone would not produce.
You do the thing every day. You are consistent and process-oriented. Results here come from showing up the same way every morning.
You are discerning with your time. You will be pulled by several Account Directors at once. You know what to say yes to, what to sequence, and what to push back on.
You ask the hard question. You are supportive and easy to work with, and you still challenge assumptions. This team is optimistic by nature and benefits from someone willing to press constructively.
You are self-directed. When something is unfamiliar, you go read, listen and dig until you can hold your own on it. You share your ideas and learnings with others on the team.
You want to win. You lead yourself, you compete, and you bring the energy to keep up with the people around you.
What Success Looks Like
Meetings that hold. You consistently create discovery meetings with the right executives, and your Account Directors walk in with context they did not have to build themselves.
Pipeline that progresses. Opportunities you source advance past first meeting because you stayed in the account and helped shape qualification.
The system gets sharper. Your AI workflows and sequences improve measurably over your first two quarters, and other people on the team adopt what you built.
You know the market. Within months you can hold a credible conversation about US payer and health system dynamics with someone who does it for a living.
You are trusted with more. You have the fundamentals of the enterprise sales motion under you and a clear path toward owning accounts.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide.

From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.
We’re looking for a Field Sales Executive, Mandarin Speaking to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us build relationships with new Chinese restaurant partners across London and surrounding cities, improving our proposition for customers and identifying ways to continue our fast growth.
Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.
What You’ll Be Doing
You’ll be joining the Chinese Category team. The Chinese Category team works alongside our entire UKI Commercial teams to drive Deliveroo’s performance across local markets, focusing on signing the best cuisine selection and expanding our footprint within this high-growth sector.

s.h: Here’s what your day-to-day might look like
s.t:
Drive regional restaurant acquisition: Map, prospect, pitch, and close high-value Chinese restaurant partners across London and surrounding territories to expand our local marketplace selection.
Execute strategic business development: Engage directly with independent restaurants in Mandarin or Cantonese via physical visits, phone calls, and social platforms to demonstrate the commercial value of Deliveroo’s technology.
Own the commercial onboarding journey: Oversee the end-to-end partner onboarding process to ensure it is fast, efficient, and seamless for new partners.
Secure early partner success: Actively support and monitor new restaurant performance within their first eight weeks on the platform to maximise their long-term growth.
Act as a local territory expert: Build deep insight into the regional Asian culinary scene, travelling across London and adjacent areas like Oxford, Cambridge, and Norwich to identify key brands that local customers crave.
What You’ll Need to Thrive
Essential
Language proficiency: Fluency in Chinese Mandarin with the ability to negotiate and build professional commercial partnerships.
Proven new business acquisition: Demonstrated sales experience with a track record of actively targeting new business and consistently delivering against demanding commercial targets.
Commercial negotiation skills: Strong commercial acumen with the ability to handle negotiations, understand marketplace economics, and structure profitable, sustainable deals.
Autonomy and field-based resilience: A self-motivated, tenacious approach with the ability to work independently and spend significant time out on the road meeting prospects.
Right to work: Valid and current right to work in the United Kingdom.

Additional language skills: Professional command or working knowledge of Cantonese.
Mobility requirement: Possession of a valid UK driving licence and access to a personal vehicle to facilitate travel across surrounding regions.

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.
We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:
🔧 Make a visible impact every day
Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.
🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment
Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.
🧠 Build a career, not just a role
Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.
🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture
Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.
We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here .
Our Global Structure
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.
If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

The Sales Associate is responsible for providing all Marine Corps Exchange (MCX) customers with world class customer service with an additional emphasis on courtesy.

Sales associates are the primary service providers and will assist customers in every aspect of the retail business in a friendly, professional, and proactive manner that supports continued customer loyalty.

Sales associates assist their customers in challenging scenarios by using an "I can do that" mindset, to make all attempts for a positive customer experience and outcomes, before asking for support from the next level mentor or supervisor.

Sales associates are brand and customer program ambassadors for all Marine Corps and MCX programs, including but not limited to, Military Star, Super Star Student, customer satisfaction surveys and Keep it New.

This position can be scheduled throughout the facility, based on the needs of the business including but not limited to, cashier or self-checkout attendant, customer service, salesfloor / department support, stockroom / backroom, and military clothing.

In addition to working indoors, associates may be required to work outdoors or inside coolers and/or chillers. Limited time durations and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided when working inside coolers and/or chillers.

Sales associates who are regularly scheduled in areas are expected to learn basic product knowledge to support customer satisfaction and service.

Sales associates perform store operations tasks such as but not limited to, customer and register transactions, Planogram revisions and setups, identifying missing products, replenish sales floor and coolers, setting promotional signage, visual merchandising, maintaining backroom standards through the 5S program and other operational tasks.

Light housekeeping tasks such as but not limited to, sweeping, dusting and trash removal may be part of daily assigned duties. Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

Assists in preparing and participates in year-end inventory and preparation. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. May require additional training or certifications as required by the business and/or normal working assignments, including but not limited to, food safety training and fuel.

Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all team members through positive conversations and driving customer satisfaction in a teams win environment. Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned.

This is a mixed position where the associate must be able to lift and carry objects up to 45 lbs. independently and objects over 45 lbs. with assistance. FOR POSITIONS AT GAS STATIONS ONLY: May assist with regular fuel lane maintenance including the handling and cleanup of hazardous materials or substances. Must wear appropriate PPE when required.

Must pass and maintain current fuel safety training as required.
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: At least 1 year experience working in a customer and sales-focused environment is preferred. Cash handling, basic math and register experience strongly preferred. Ability to read and understand operating standards and procedures for service, service recovery, sales and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly. Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals. Attention to detail is required.

Wonderly gives Main Street businesses the AI agents, capital, and growth team they need to scale, and charges nothing for any of it. We only get paid one way: when they make real money.

We own the entire system of record, all business applications (we replace ServiceTitan, House Call Pro, RingCentral, Squarespace, Docusign, Square, and a dozen other applications), and dozens of AI agents ourselves embedded natively inside our business applications, with native data read & write access to our system of record.

Wonderly has the most result-driven business model, because we’ve proven our system and AI Agents work. We are not trying to sell our customers a dream - we deliver real revenue and profit to our customers. All of our software and AI Agents are free - we charge a % of revenue we deliver for our customers.

Each of our 10+ core AI Agents help improve their revenue by 5-20%. This is the ultimate outcome-based pricing, only possible when you own the entire end-to-end system and all the agents yourself.

About the Hiring Manager
Hey, I'm Bishop, Head of Customer Experience at Wonderly .
I started in FP&A, realized I wanted to be in the middle of building something instead of analyzing it from the outside, and ended up here.
I'm hiring early-career operators who can sell. People I can put on the phone with a business owner and trust to open the relationship, run the conversation, and move the deal forward. The role I'm hiring for is the role I would have killed for at 22.

You own the top of our funnel. You'll run outbound to service business owners — cold calls, follow-ups, whatever it takes to get them on the phone — pitch the Wonderly model, qualify for fit, and hand the hot ones off (often live) to our team to close.
You're the first human a future customer talks to. The pipeline grows because you make it grow.
This is not a read-from-a-script seat. Our outbound motion is early, and you'll help build the playbook, not inherit a finished one. When something in the process is broken, you flag it and help fix it.
The work is hands-on and high-volume. You'll live on the phone, own your number, keep your pipeline and CRM tight, and feed what you're hearing back into how we target and message. You're not above the grind, and you're not just a dialer either — you think about how to make the whole motion better.
And it's not only calls. We have aggressive growth goals, and hitting them means the outbound engine has to scale — which means digging into your own data, spotting what's working and what isn't, and helping build the systems and process that let us do 10x the volume without falling apart.

You'll analyze your numbers, surface patterns, and help stand up the tooling and playbook that scale us. The best people here don't just hit their number, they help build the machine that makes everyone's number easier to hit.
If you want a defined script and a narrow lane, this isn't it. If you want to carry a number, build the outbound engine with us, and get dramatically better at selling fast, apply.
What Makes This Role Different
Most early-career sales roles are narrow. You join, you run someone else's script, you get good at one motion.
This is the opposite. You're getting in early on the outbound engine of a company that's scaling fast — which means outsized ownership, real influence on the playbook, and a front-row seat to how a company goes from early traction to serious scale. Top performers here move fast into senior sales, team lead, and ops roles.

As an Outbound Sales Development Representative (SDR), you make the first impression! You’ll use ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Outreach, and Salesforce to identify, engage and qualify prospective customers. You’ll also partner with our Account Executives by creating a pipeline of opportunities for them to close, schedule meetings, shadow demos, etc.
If you're highly motivated, not afraid to make a cold call, and are looking to break into the fast-paced world of software sales, this could be the position for you!

You’re a driven, results-oriented sales professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is motivated by uncapped earning potential. You’re excited by the opportunity to work with fascinating customers and prospects across a wide range of industries—because nearly every organization that operates a fleet is a potential Fleetio customer.

You’ll be responsible for sourcing and identify, engage and qualify prospective customers to drive ARR growth. You’re eager to join a team of “A” players who are passionate, supportive, and committed to success.

Whether you’re working remotely from anywhere in the U.S. or from our HQ in Birmingham, AL, you’ll find a collaborative, customer-centric culture where your contributions matter and your success is celebrated.

You will manage outbound lead generation for our Mid-Market territory by researching and contacting (cold calling, emailing, social, etc.) prospective customers to understand their business needs and educate them on how Fleetio can help them achieve their goals
Actively source new leads and develop detailed lead profiles in our CRM (Salesforce)
Qualify prospect accounts and schedule meetings and demos with our Account Executives
Assist in other strategic efforts to create qualified sales opportunities for Fleetio
Develop and refine skills that will contribute to your success as an Outbound SDR and will be transferable to other opportunities as you grow (i.e., Lead SDR, Account Executive, etc.)

1+ years of experience in Outbound sales, preferably as an SDR or AE
Self-motivated with an outstanding work ethic
Coachable & Eager to Learn
Team Player
Resilient, fearless, and persistent
Problem solver with strong attention to detail

s.h: WHAT DOES A WORK AT HOME CONTACT CENTER REPRESENTATIVE DO?
s.t:
This position supports customer service, technical support, and customer sales interactions. This role requires you to interact with hundreds of customers each week across the country to resolve support issues, sell new products and services, and ensure best in class customer experience.

In addition to being the best in the business when it comes to customer interactions, you will need to be confident, fully engaged, a team player, and dedicated to bringing a positive and enthusiastic outlook to work each day.
Our entry-level Contact Center Representatives are responsible for the following tasks:
Listen to customers, understand their needs, and resolve customer issues
Utilize systems and technology to complete account management tasks
Recognize sales opportunity and apply sales skills to upgrade
Explain and position the products and processes with customers
Appropriately escalate customer dissatisfaction with managerial team
Ensure first call resolution through problems solving and effective call handling

# Stabsmitarbeiter:in Direktion Untersuchungsgefängnisse Zürich (UGZ) 80 - 100% #
Justizvollzug und Wiedereingliederung (JuWe) ist als Teil der Direktion der Justiz und des Innern des Kantons Zürich für den Straf- und Massnahmenvollzug sowie die Durchführung der verschiedenen Haftarten verantwortlich. Für unsere 1'400 Mitarbeitenden sind die erfolgreiche soziale Wiedereingliederung von straffällig gewordenen Menschen und die Verhinderung von Rückfällen von besonderer Bedeutung.
Die Untersuchungsgefängnisse Zürich (UGZ) sind eine von acht Hauptabteilungen von JuWe, umfassen sieben Betriebe mit rund 700 Gefängnisplätzen und etwa 500 Mitarbeitenden. Sie sind zuständig für die vorläufige Festnahme, die Untersuchungs- und Sicherheitshaft sowie den vorzeitigen Straf- und Massnahmenvollzug bis zur Überführung in eine Vollzugseinrichtung. Damit erfüllen sie eine zentrale Funktion innerhalb des Zürcher Justizsystems.
Per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung suchen wir eine engagierte und initiative Persönlichkeit, die unsere Hauptabteilungsleiterin mit Weitblick, Organisationsgeschick und Tatkraft unterstützt.
### Das erwartet Dich ###
* Du arbeitest eng mit der Direktorin UGZ zusammen und unterstützt sie dabei, strategische und operative Themen voranzutreiben, zu strukturieren und in die Umsetzung zu bringen
* Du gestaltest den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung des Stabs UGZ aktiv mit und entwickelst Instrumente und Grundlagen, die eine wirkungsvolle Führung und Zusammenarbeit unterstützen
* Du arbeitest dich rasch in komplexe Fragestellungen ein, analysierst unterschiedliche Informationen und verdichtest sie zu klaren Entscheidungsgrundlagen, Konzepten, Berichten und Präsentationen
* Du konzipierst und koordinierst Sitzungen, Retraiten und Kadertage und sorgst dafür, dass aus Diskussionen konkrete Entscheidungen und nächste Schritte entstehen, die du in der Umsetzung aktiv begleitest und vorantreibst
* Du bist Sparringspartner:in für die Direktorin und den Stab, bringst eigene Perspektiven ein, wirkst aktiv in Projekten mit und trägst dazu bei, die UGZ organisatorisch und inhaltlich weiterzuentwickeln
### Das bist Du ###
* Du hast ein Hochschulstudium (Universität oder FH) abgeschlossen und bringst idealerweise Erfahrung aus einem komplexen organisatorischen Umfeld mit
* Du kannst komplexe Themen rasch erfassen, Zusammenhänge erkennen und daraus klare Prioritäten und nächste Schritte ableiten
* Du arbeitest selbständig und strukturiert, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen und behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn mehrere Dinge gleichzeitig laufen
* Du bringst Erfahrung in der Organisationsentwicklung mit und weisst, dass Veränderungen nicht nur gute Konzepte, sondern auch ein gutes Gespür für Organisationen und Menschen brauchen
* Projektarbeit ist dir vertraut. Du kannst Vorhaben strukturieren, unterschiedliche Beteiligte zusammenbringen und Themen konsequent vorantreiben
### Das bieten wir Dir ###
* Eine vielseitige und herausfordernde Tätigkeit in einem spannenden und nicht alltäglichen Umfeld
* Einblick in strategische und operative Themen einer grossen öffentlichen Organisation
* Eine sorgfältige Einarbeitung sowie Unterstützung durch ein engagiertes Team
* Attraktive Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
* Einen zentralen Arbeitsplatz in Zürich Altstetten
* Anstellungsbedingungen nach kantonalen Richtlinien
### Und was jetzt? ###
Mach mit uns den nächsten Schritt in deiner beruflichen Laufbahn und schick uns deine Bewerbung über unser Online-Tool. Wir freuen uns auf dein Dossier.
Noch Fragen? Nathalie Dorn, Direktorin UGZ, beantwortet dir fachliche Fragen gerne unter 043 258 37 09.
Fragen rund um den Bewerbungsprozess beantwortet dir das Team Rekrutierung & Assessment unter 043 258 35 83.
Das JuWe setzt im Rahmen des Bewerbungsprozesses ein Online Assessment ein. Weitere Informationen zu unserem Rekrutierungsprozess und zur Anstellung im JuWe sind unter Arbeiten bei JuWe | Kanton Zürich (zh.ch) zu finden.
